openai/gpt-oss-120b.markdown:
# CE+DBG 寻找基地址 知识图谱

## 总览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CE["Cheat Engine (CE)"]
    DBG["Debugger (DBG)"]
    SameAddr["CE 与 DBG 寻址相同"]
    Scan["扫描地址"]
    Breakpoint["设置断点"]
    BaseAddr["获取基地址"]
    LimDBG["DBG 不能搜索数值"]
    PrefCE["CE 更常用"]
    FuncSame["功能相同"]
    Diff["唯一缺点: 不能搜索值"]
    Attach["附加游戏进程"]
    FindHP["定位当前血量地址"]
    CopyAddr["复制地址"]
    Convert["转换为四字节十六进制"]
    Filter["过滤结果"]
    Observe["观察访问数据"]
    IdentifyBase["识别基地址"]
    UseEx["使用 EX + 0x80 计算基址"]

    CE --> SameAddr
    DBG --> SameAddr
    SameAddr --> FuncSame
    CE --> Scan
    DBG --> Scan
    Scan --> Breakpoint
    Breakpoint --> BaseAddr
    BaseAddr --> IdentifyBase
    IdentifyBase --> UseEx
    CE --> LimDBG
    LimDBG --> Diff
    Diff --> PrefCE
    Attach --> FindHP
    FindHP --> CopyAddr
    CopyAddr --> Convert
    Convert --> Filter
    Filter --> Observe
    Observe --> IdentifyBase
```

## 寻址流程
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start["开始：附加游戏进程"]
    ScanHP["扫描血量数值 (686 → 685)"]
    ModifyHP["修改血量数值验证"]
    Verify["确认修改有效"]
    SetBP["在血量地址设置断点"]
    Run["运行游戏触发断点"]
    AccessData["记录访问该地址的指令"]
    IdentifyEX["定位 EX 寄存器来源"]
    CalcBase["计算基地址：EDI = EX + 0x80"]
    CopyBase["复制基地址"]
    End["结束：得到基地址"]

    Start --> ScanHP --> ModifyHP --> Verify --> SetBP --> Run --> AccessData --> IdentifyEX --> CalcBase --> CopyBase --> End
```

## CE 与 DBG 对比
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CE["Cheat Engine (CE)"]
    DBG["Debugger (DBG)"]
    FuncSame["功能相同：调试/寻址"]
    SearchVal["可搜索数值"]
    NoSearch["不能搜索数值"]
    C1Mode["C1 模式（CE）"]
    Preference["C1 使用更广"]

    CE --> FuncSame
    DBG --> FuncSame
    CE --> SearchVal
    DBG --> NoSearch
    NoSearch --> Preference
    SearchVal --> C1Mode
    C1Mode --> Preference
```

## 基地址计算关系
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    AddrHP["血量地址"]
    EXReg["EX 寄存器"]
    Offset80["偏移 0x80"]
    EDIReg["EDI 寄存器"]
    BaseAddr["基地址"]
    Calc["EDI = EX + 0x80"]
    BP["断点触发访问"]
    DataAccess["访问数据记录"]

    AddrHP --> BP
    BP --> DataAccess
    DataAccess --> EXReg
    EXReg --> Calc
    Offset80 --> Calc
    Calc --> EDIReg
    EDIReg --> BaseAddr
```
